title: Insurance and maximum claim amount
keywords: insurance extra cover claim maximum how much compensation $100 lost damaged value
body: Extra cover must be added before checkout: 1.2% (1 Hour Rush), 1.5% (Same Day / 3 Hours / 2-Way), 2% (Next Day / time slot). Extended cover is capped at $2,000 per shipment. Favourite Fleet can't be selected with extra insurance.
Without extra cover, compensation is the lower of the item's cost price or $100 per delivery order, with proof of value.
Parcels worth more than $2,000 are not accepted.
